item.text: The scan traversal currently starts at `"."` inside `os.DirFS`, and `isDirEmpty` uses the same virtual path. I’m switching those to absolute/native paths, retaining sorted incremental directory reads and the existing skip/error logs. The Windows-specific ignored-folder behavior is defined in a platform test and will remain intact.

The main implementation now uses `os.Stat`, `os.Open`, and absolute joined paths, with readability checks centralized in `utils.IsDirReadable`. Existing scanner tests still target the old `fs.FS` signatures, so I’m updating those tests to exercise native directory entries and native traversal while retaining the partial-read/error cases where possible.

item.text:
Restored directory scanning to native OS filesystem operations with absolute paths. Added [utils/paths.go](/app/utils/paths.go) with `IsDirReadable`, and updated the tag scanner and traversal tests.

`go test ./scanner ./utils` passes, and `git diff --check` is clean. The build emitted an existing TagLib deprecation warning.
